reason: The cited evidence confirms that NbMoTaWV is brittle at room temperature (E1), but neither E1 nor E2 provides any data on Ti additions, grain boundary segregation, or their effects on cohesion and ductility in this alloy system. The key mechanistic and performance premises are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: NbMoTaWV is brittle at room temperature
Ti addition can enhance grain boundary cohesion
Ti segregates to grain boundaries in BCC refractory HEAs
Enhanced grain boundary cohesion suppresses intergranular brittleness and improves ductility
Minor Ti addition does not significantly reduce yield strength
